Write the whole-module specification

module rtlpp_00826(CLOCK, 
                 A, 
                 B, 
                 C, 
                 D);
   
   input CLOCK;
   output A;
   output B;
   output C;
   output D;
   
   reg A_DUMMY;
   reg B_DUMMY;
   reg C_DUMMY;
   reg D_DUMMY;
   
   assign A = A_DUMMY;
   assign B = B_DUMMY;
   assign C = C_DUMMY;
   assign D = D_DUMMY;
   
   reg XLXN_2 = 1;
   wire XLXN_6;
   wire XLXN_11;
   wire XLXN_22;
   wire XLXN_26;
   
   assign XLXN_6 = !A_DUMMY;
   assign XLXN_11 = XLXN_6 & D_DUMMY;
   assign XLXN_22 = D_DUMMY & C_DUMMY;
   assign XLXN_26 = B_DUMMY & C_DUMMY & D_DUMMY;
   
   always @(posedge CLOCK)
     begin
       if (!XLXN_2 & XLXN_2)
         D_DUMMY <= 0;
       else if (XLXN_2 & !XLXN_2)
         D_DUMMY <= 1;
       else if (XLXN_2 & XLXN_2)
         D_DUMMY <= !D_DUMMY;
      
       if (!XLXN_11 & D_DUMMY)
         C_DUMMY <= 0;
       else if (XLXN_11 & !D_DUMMY)
         C_DUMMY <= 1;
       else if (XLXN_11 & D_DUMMY)
         C_DUMMY <= !C_DUMMY;
      
       if (!XLXN_22 & XLXN_22)
         B_DUMMY <= 0;
       else if (XLXN_22 & !XLXN_22)
         B_DUMMY <= 1;
       else if (XLXN_22 & XLXN_22)
         B_DUMMY <= !B_DUMMY;
      
       if (!XLXN_26 & D_DUMMY)
         A_DUMMY <= 0;
       else if (XLXN_26 & !D_DUMMY)
         A_DUMMY <= 1;
       else if (XLXN_26 & D_DUMMY)
         A_DUMMY <= !A_DUMMY;
     end
   
endmodule
